what: Pass A thinking-level arms on one real 20-minute window (ADR-0007, jld-hc9.1)
prompt: prompts.PASS_A, unchanged since the first commit
note: Timestamps and counts only — no utterance text; this repo is public. address_forms is the jld-86b canary: cue lines whose label matches the address form they contain.

model_default_probe.comment: Patient single call, no thinking_config, no retry — to establish where the model's own default sits. Not scored for diarization.

reference.comment: The 2026-08-20 windowed Pass A run of the same window — the run whose merged transcript later scored 89% against 41 blind hand labels (jld-dli).

verbatim_proxy.comment: Student filler rate per 1,000 student characters, and total student characters. A transcriber drifting toward fluent text drops fillers; none of the arms did.

synthetic_lesson.comment: work/test/test_lesson.m4a, 34 s, 4 runs per arm. 'stalls' are aborted streams that _with_retry re-rolled. 'planted_uncorrected_preserved' is 「面白いでした」 surviving un-normalised — see jld-5vz. No arm preserves the planted uncorrected error reliably, so that is model drift rather than a level effect (jld-5vz).
